attchmntText: Mahamaya Steel Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Mahamaya Steel Industries Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 during its Board meeting on 13th November 2026. The Limited Review Report by auditors Chopra AJ & Associates contains no modifications. For the six months ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 52,334.47 lakhs, compared to 39,561.82 lakhs in the same period last year. Net profit after tax stood at 469.67 lakhs, up from 306.37 lakhs previously. Earnings per share were 2.86. Total assets as of 30th September 2026 were 23,795.35 lakhs. Cash flow from operating activities for the half year was 4,117.96 lakhs. The company has one reportable business segment, the Steel Segment.
